message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | State / Colony |
|--------|----------------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts (his signature is famously large) |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia (author of the draft) |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| George Washington | Virginia (though he did not sign the original document, his name appears on later copies) |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York (did not sign the original but was present at the signing) |

Other notable signers include Roger Sherman (New York), Robert R. Livingston (New York), and John Jay (New York). The full list includes representatives from each colony, such as William Paca (Maryland), Richard Henry Lee (Virginia), and many others.
